canonical_example.text: El empresario tiene cuentas en bancos extranjeros.

canonical_example.text: Hay muchos extranjeros que viven en Nueva York.

canonical_example.translation: My grandparents have never traveled abroad.

canonical_example.translation: That brother of yours is always looking for trouble.

canonical_example.translation: He died at an early age.

canonical_example.translation: It's 10 am already. I mean, when does the person in charge get here?

canonical_example.translation: The guilty party will be found, tried, and imprisoned.

canonical_example.translation: Tenants are liable for any damages to the apartment.

canonical_example.translation: Who is the culprit of this terrible crime?

canonical_example.translation: Carmen was honest and told her boyfriend the whole truth about her past.

canonical_example.translation: I would like to change the francs left over from my trip to Switzerland into dollars.

canonical_example.translation: I want to be open with you; I've been in love with you for some time.

canonical_example.translation: The country's economy has shown marked improvement in the last quarter.

canonical_example.translation: My father never hid his clear dislike of my boyfriend.

canonical_example.translation: The soldier is on guard duty today, but tomorrow he is off duty.

canonical_example.translation: Go to sleep, Susi! It's really late already!

canonical_example.translation: Live a magical and unforgettable experience for an unbelievable price.

canonical_example.translation: The teacher ordered the student out of the classroom for to his bad behavior.

canonical_example.translation: At last, the wind was dying down.
